subject: Caravan Stalker
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

scaleCalibrationReview.note: Manual rigid cranial-cap chord on one comparable right-facing pose per clip aligns move, attack and death to the corrected all-quadrupedal idle; action-dependent body bounding boxes are excluded.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-pose inspection of the posterior pelvis immediately ahead of the tail root. Anchor x is the pelvis projection; anchor y preserves that physical support plane while including the one- or two-pixel extraction guard beneath it so every complete source pixel remains inside the normalized cell. Tail, skull and claw extrema never determine the root. Every proposal is rechecked on the rendered source overlay before merge.
